units.source_text: 是的，这就是我女婿的尸体。

en.t: Yes, this is the body of my son-in-law.

units.source_text: 他不是京城本地人，他来自若狭国府，是一位武士。

en.t: He was not from the capital; he came from Wakasa provincial office and was a warrior.

units.source_text: 我女婿叫金泽武弘，今年二十六岁。

en.t: My son-in-law was named Kanazawa Takehiro, and he was twenty-six this year.

units.source_text: 并没有，他性格非常好，不可能有忌恨他的仇家。

en.t: No, he had a very good character, so it is impossible that he had enemies who hated him.
